name: manual_8127a7
claim: Gate 4 Half B (PT agent_launcher.py's adoption of the dedicated model-server dialer) is blocked on PT PR #380 merging first

decisions.notes: orama-system docs/v2/66 sequences Half B (routing agent_launcher.py's model-server override path through the new dialer instead of raw httpx) strictly after PR #380 lands, since #380 is the smallest-safe interim fix (remove caller-supplied /health overrides) and the dialer work builds on top of that landed state, not in parallel with it. Half B is also explicitly scoped as its own human-reviewed PT PR, never a same-repo edit landed directly by an agent, per the v1/v2 regime boundary in ADR 62.
